newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia sells HRK103.9 million T-bills, rate down.
newsitem.headline: Croatia sells HRK103.9 million T-bills, rate down.

text.p: The Croatian Finance Ministry raised 103.9 million kuna through a fresh issue of 42-day treasury bills, it said Tuesday.
The issue was priced higher at 98.919 and the rate was down to 9.5 percent from 9.75 four weeks ago.
The ministry planned to raise 120 million, but fell short of target despite the offers exceeding 200 million.
The share of the non-banking sector in the issue was 22.4 percent. For full details see page MFHT.
Bills are payable on May 15 and mature on June 26.

The ministry set the next auction for May 20, when it will offer 50 million kuna in 182-day T-bills. Foreign investors can participate indirectly by bidding through local banks. -- Davor Huic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
